name: multiple_choice: Hoping to gain a foothold in the competitive cloud…

request.questionText: Hoping to gain a foothold in the competitive cloud computing market, software-as-a-service start-up firm Nimbus 2K is weighing the uncertainty around a proposal to pursue a major contract. Their data scientist estimates the following set of potential outcomes: There is a 20% chance the firm wins the contract and earns a profit of $500,000 There is a 15% chance the firm wins the contract but incurs higher expenses, earning a profit of $300,000 Otherwise, the firm loses the contract and they earn no profit. The expected value of the contract profit is closest to which of the following?
